historical_record_policy: The 0.2.6 G15 record and earlier 0.2.7 execution records are historical evidence. Their recorded SHAs are not rewritten to reflect the current development head.

level_up_2.theme: Reproducible Large-Model Performance and Solver Maturity
level_up_2.wp02_limitation: Preflight, redistribution, communication and I/O are explicitly unmeasured because the legacy runner does not expose separate boundaries; no phase is inferred from total time.
level_up_2.wp03_owner_decision: PASS_WITH_LIMITATIONS: two replays of a materially distinct 3M workload pass the unchanged WP02 configuration and numerical contract; the claim remains bounded to the recorded route.
level_up_2.wp03_limitation: Preflight, redistribution, communication and I/O remain explicitly NOT_MEASURED; no universal, multi-node, GPU, mixed-mesh, nonlinear or restart claim is made.
level_up_2.wp08_owner_decision: Explicit defer/research decisions preserve the existing bounded HEX8 route and do not promote a capability.
level_up_2.wp07_owner_decision: Existing route maturity retained at bounded combination scope; no promotion or demotion.
level_up_2.wp04_blocker: The owner-terminated retry reached rank-zero local PC_READY but exposed a proven post-ready collective-order mismatch. The patched frozen route requires replay; the 2x time overrun remains only a budget observation. No Bronze or 5M solve claim is made.

release_workflow_policy: Publication must run from a tag reference whose v-prefixed name matches the package version. Manual confirmation does not bypass this contract.
